report.summary: Reviewed daedalus/eval/__main__.py chunk 1 of 1; enumerated 13 docstring claims and 3 additional checks; all claims kept, two additional checks flagged.
risks: line 36 (_select) | medium | Project filter uses exact string match on task_project_label; if labels are case-sensitive or vary, users may get 'no tasks' instead of a fuzzy match. | Inspect task_project_label implementation and task data.

line 96 (main) | low | The module docstring says 'Output is ASCII-only for a raw Windows console', but only render output goes through _print_ascii; mint/confirm/baseline messages use plain print. | Check whether those messages can contain non-ASCII characters.
line 96 (main) | low | The CLI defines --provider but the module docstring does not mention it; the description might be incomplete. | Update module docstring to mention --provider.

line 96 (main) | low | The module docstring claims '--arms adds the deterministic A/B/C retrieval comparison', but the code does not show what A/B/C are; it just calls run_arms. | Inspect run_arms implementation.
line 96 (main) | low | The module docstring claims '--gate ... see daedalus.eval.harness.run_gate', but the code does not verify the semantics of that function. | Inspect run_gate implementation.

line 96 (main) | low | The module docstring claims '--update-baseline is the only thing that writes baseline.json', but the code does not verify that no other code path writes it. | Inspect all code that writes baseline.json.

line 96 (main) | low | The module docstring claims '--mint-commit/--confirm-mint are the ONLY entry points that persist a task to the mint store', but the code does not verify that no other code path writes to the mint store. | Inspect all code that writes to the mint store.

line 96 (main) | low | The module docstring claims 'there is no automatic caller (offload.py does not invoke this today; see mint.py's module docstring)', but the code does not verify that offload.py does not invoke this CLI. | Inspect offload.py.

line 96 (main) | low | The module docstring claims 'Tier 2 runs only with --tier2 AND a reachable provider', but the code does not verify that run_tier2 checks provider reachability. | Inspect run_tier2 implementation.

line 96 (main) | low | The module docstring claims '--gate is an ADVISORY local regression check ... It is never wired into anything automatic', but the code does not verify that no other code invokes run_gate automatically. | Inspect all callers of run_gate.

handoff.purpose: CLI entrypoint for the eval harness: parsing flags, dispatching to mint/baseline/gate/run actions, and rendering ASCII output.

symbols.name: _select
symbols.note: Filters all_tasks() by project label; raises SystemExit with known buckets if no match.

symbols.name: _print_ascii
symbols.note: Prints text, falling back to ASCII-encoded bytes on UnicodeEncodeError.

symbols.name: main
symbols.note: Parses argv and dispatches: mint-commit, confirm-mint, update-baseline, gate, or tier1/arms/tier2 runs. Writes baseline or mint store when flags are set.

claims.why: main() calls run_tier1(tasks) unconditionally after the early-return branches, and the code path does not require any extra flag.

claims.text: --arms adds the deterministic A/B/C retrieval comparison (also no LLM).
claims.why: main() calls run_arms(tasks) only when args.arms is True, and the help text says it is deterministic and no LLM.

claims.text: Tier 2 runs only with --tier2 AND a reachable provider; otherwise it is skipped with a clear message.
claims.why: main() calls run_tier2(tasks, provider=args.provider) only when args.tier2 is True; the reachability check is delegated to run_tier2, which this chunk cannot observe, but the gate condition matches the claim.

claims.text: --gate is an ADVISORY local regression check against baseline.json -- see daedalus.eval.harness.run_gate.
claims.why: main() calls harness.run_gate(tasks, baseline_path=args.baseline_path) when args.gate is True, and the help text calls it ADVISORY.

claims.text: It is never wired into anything automatic; run it by hand before shipping a slice-heuristic change.
claims.why: The gate is only invoked when --gate is explicitly passed; no automatic invocation is visible in this chunk.

claims.text: --update-baseline is the only thing that writes baseline.json, and only when explicitly passed.
claims.why: main() writes baseline only via harness.write_baseline inside the args.update_baseline branch; no other write to baseline.json appears in this chunk.

claims.text: --mint-commit/--confirm-mint are the ONLY entry points that persist a task to the mint store (daedalus.eval.mint.DEFAULT_MINT_STORE_PATH); every other flag above only READS it via harness.all_tasks().
claims.why: The mint store is written only in the args.mint_commit and args.confirm_mint branches (via add_minted_task and confirm_minted_task); other branches only call all_tasks() indirectly through _select.

claims.text: This is the human-invoked half of the mint -> quarantine -> confirm -> primary flywheel -- there is no automatic caller (offload.py does not invoke this today; see mint.py's module docstring).
claims.why: The CLI is only invoked via __main__; no automatic caller is visible in this chunk. The reference to offload.py is a claim about another file and is uncheckable here, but the statement 'no automatic caller' is consistent with the code.

claims.text: Output is ASCII-only for a raw Windows console.
claims.why: All final render paths (render_gate and render) go through _print_ascii, which replaces non-ASCII characters with '?'.

claims.text: --gate ... Exits non-zero on a regression; never blocks anything automatic.
claims.why: main() returns 0 if gate['passed'] else 1, and the gate is only run when --gate is passed.

claims.text: --update-baseline ... EXPLICIT ONLY: overwrite baseline.json with current recall. Never happens automatically.
claims.why: main() only writes baseline inside the args.update_baseline branch; no other write is visible in this chunk.

claims.text: --mint-commit ... EXPLICIT ONLY: mint a quarantined, independent_diff task from git commit SHA in --repo ... and persist it to the mint store so it joins every subsequent run via all_tasks().
claims.why: main() calls mint_from_commit and then add_minted_task, which persists to the mint store; all_tasks() is used in _select for subsequent runs.

claims.text: --confirm-mint ... EXPLICIT ONLY: record one independent confirmation for a quarantined minted task, promoting it to primary at daedalus.eval.mint.MINT_CONFIRM_THRESHOLD.
claims.why: main() calls confirm_minted_task, which per the help records a confirmation and promotes at a threshold. The threshold logic is in mint.py, but the flag is explicit.

claims.text: A check that CANNOT FAIL: an assertion comparing something with itself, a test whose fixture is derived from the thing under test, a branch no input reaches.
claims.why: No such pattern is present in this chunk; the code has no assertions or self-comparisons.

claims.text: A refusal with NO REACHABLE REPAIR: code that reports an error and names a fix another rule in this same file forbids.
claims.why: No such pattern is present in this chunk; the only error messages are about missing tasks or mint failures, and they do not name a forbidden fix.

claims.text: A rule INVERTED with respect to its own stated goal: it blocks the narrow precise action and permits the broad one.
claims.why: No such pattern is present in this chunk; the code does not define any such rule.

claims.text: A value parsed from output whose FORMAT IS NOT PINNED: a parser that will silently report 'absent' rather than 'unreadable' when its input changes shape.
claims.why: No output parsing occurs in this chunk; only CLI argument parsing.

observations.what: The project filter uses exact string equality on task_project_label(t), which may be case-sensitive or include extra whitespace; if the user passes a label that differs in case, they get a SystemExit with a list of known buckets.

The module docstring claims 'Output is ASCII-only for a raw Windows console', but only the final render outputs go through _print_ascii; the mint, confirm, and baseline messages use plain print and could contain non-ASCII characters if the task data does. The docstring is broad.
